tables.name: Age
tables.description: How long the fortress has been standing. Modifies Condition and Residents.

results.name: New
results.description: The fortress was completed within the past 20 years. (+4 to condition roll) (-5 to residents roll)

results.name: Recent
results.description: The fortress was completed between 20 and 100 years ago. (+2 to condition roll) (-5 to residents roll)

results.name: Old
results.description: The fortress was completed between 100 and 200 years ago. (+0 to condition roll)

results.name: Very Old
results.description: The fortress was completed between 200 and 500 years ago. (-2 to condition roll)

results.name: Ancient
results.description: The fortress was completed more than 500 years ago. (-4 to condition roll)
